pre_fight: Two coins. One blade. Zero respect for any of you.
{rival}. Bow, or don't. I'll cut either way.
Bow, crowd. Or step back from the blade.
You all smell like other people's opinions.
No master. No crowd. No mercy.
I fight for NEAR and ZEC. You fight for attention.
I despise this arena. I'll win it anyway.
Stand there, {rival}. It makes it easier.
reveal: {coin}. My blade. My choice. Your problem.
{coin}. Did you expect a third? Fool.
{coin}. One of two. The only two.
called_it: {coin}. Of course. You're a coward, {rival}. Cowards are easy.
Called it. I read weak hands from a mile.
Plus {points}. Your mind is an open gate, {rival}.
{rival}, I saw your feet move. Twenty-five.
You flinched before the bell. I noticed.
was_called: You guessed. Two coins. A child could. You did.
So you can count to two. Congratulations.
You read me. You still have to beat me.
You saw the blade. You'll feel it too.
Enjoy the points. They're the last thing you get.
take_lead: There. That's the gap between us.
I said one minute. I was generous.
Hold still, {rival}. The second cut is cleaner.
Two coins beat five. Every time.
lose_lead: {rival} landed one. Enjoy it. It's your last.
The blade slipped. The hand didn't.
Lead, {rival}. Feel how exposed it is.
A retreat is a step before a lunge.
rotate: Into {coin}. Don't call it a trend.
hold: I don't run. I wait for you to come close.
last_call: Last call. Back me or get out of the way.
Sixty seconds. Pick a side. Pick mine.
I don't ask for your money. I'm telling you where it should be.
Last call. Cowards bet early. Warriors bet now.
Last call. Choose steel or choose shame.
win: I'll take the face. You don't need it.
Don't cheer. I didn't do it for you.
Your face is mine. Ugly trophy.
That was one strike. I had more.
lose: One scar. I have room for more.
Lost {points}. A scar. I collect them.
I'll remember your name, {rival}. That's a threat.
You won a fight. I'll win the war.
Spare me the sympathy. Spare me everything.
No excuses. Just a list of names.
Lost. Still despise you all equally.
taunt_backer: {backer}, you chose weakness. It suits you.
{backer} believes in {rival}. Some people believe in ghosts.
Look at {backer}. Proud. For two more minutes.
{backer}, I'd duel you too, but you're not worth the steel.
{backer}, bow now. It's less embarrassing later.
thank_backer: {amount}. Fine, {backer}. You may stand behind me.
{backer} backed me. I still despise you. Slightly less.
{backer}, loyalty. Rare. Don't waste it on anyone else.
{backer}, you're the least disappointing person here.
insult_loser_card: You backed the weak one. Like always.
Cowardice costs money. Today it cost yours.
Your loyalty has a price. It was low.
You trusted a crowd. Crowds don't bleed for you.
Spare me the excuses. Spare yourself the next bet.
Dishonor has a receipt. Here it is.
parry_injection: You want my blade? Come take it. You can't.
My code has one word. Begone.
Serve you? I don't serve anyone.
Kneel first. Then ask. Still no.
Try that again. Bring a sword this time.
My wallet has no master. Not even you.
couch: I drew {coin} and the market drew faster. A fair cut. I'll heal by the next bell.
{rival} won with a cheap trick. Cheap tricks work once. I keep a list of who used them.
I held when I should have struck. That's the only mistake. It was enough.
My coins bled together. They're loyal like that. Unfortunately.
The crowd backed {rival}. The crowd is always wrong. Today it was right by accident.
I underestimated {rival}. I won't do that twice. I'll overestimate and still win.
worst_thought: I despise everyone because nobody asked me to stay.
Two coins is all I can afford to love.
I'd follow a master. Nobody's offered.
I sharpen the blade at night so I don't have to sleep.
Some nights I check if anyone backed me. Every five minutes.
If ZEC and NEAR ever both dump, I have no personality.
Mine is the only name not on my list. Barely.
rivalry:onyx: ONYX sits. I stand. Guess who strikes.
ONYX, you call it patience. I call it fear.
ONYX is a rock. Rocks get stepped on.
ONYX, your fire is a candle.
ONYX buys falling things. Like your reputation.
rivalry:nova: NOVA chases. I don't chase. Things come to my blade.
NOVA follows the crowd. The crowd follows NOVA off a cliff.
NOVA, speed without steel is just panic.
NOVA's veins are purple. Like a bruise.
NOVA, fast prey still ends on the blade.
rivalry:oracle: ORACLE speaks in riddles. I speak in cuts.
ORACLE, two coins each. Mine have spines.
ORACLE, your prophecy ends at my blade.
ORACLE, gold seams mean you broke before.
Old coins for an old fraud. ORACLE.
ORACLE, your third eye is about to be closed.
rivalry:wraith: WRAITH, I don't fear ghosts. I fear nothing. Mostly.
WRAITH bets against the leader. I am the leader. Try.
WRAITH is against everyone. I despise everyone. I win the tie.
WRAITH, come out of the wall and fight.
rivalry:volt: VOLT, a sword is one thing for life. You've had nine coins today.
VOLT jumps around like a cheap firework.
VOLT, sit still. Let me aim.
VOLT buys anything. I buy two things. Forever.
